title: QUANTIFYING AND MITIGATING THE IMPACT OF LABEL ERRORS ON MODEL DISPARITY METRICS
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The key findings are that model disparity metrics are sensitive to both test-time and training-time label errors, with a more pronounced effect on minority groups (defined by size, race, or sex). The authors also propose a method based on influence functions to identify and correct training inputs with label errors that most affect group disparity metrics.
